cues: He tells Adèle the truth about his past, asks her to care for her sisters, forbids her to speak ill of their mother, and drinks from a glass.
Smoke forces its way through the ceiling; bells ring in the distance.
You have taken poison, Adèle cries.
He nods, asks if she has the insurance papers, begins: tell Thérèse, and Annette, and his head falls.
